ratings_why.fun: Setting each Lid's count before the fight and watching spiders burst out mid-fight is a real treat, but hidden counters and out-of-turn strikes cost some at-a-glance reading.
ratings_why.distinct: What earns 8 over 7: the board you show is not the board you fight with, and a per-unit timing dial that also fools scouting and the attack-first rule is something no current tribe or generic auto-battler does.

verdict_why: One real wording gap (whether the Worshipful Master's fight buff reaches Lids) is worth a quick pass; the rest reads well.

points.text: Worshipful Master says "your other units", but in a fight Lids don't count as units, so players can't tell if waiting Lids get the +1/+1. Say "face-up units" or "units and Lids".
The Lie in Wait reminder is about 150 words; the card face needs a two-line short form ("Hidden in fights. Springs after N enemy attacks, then strikes.") with the full rule in the glossary.
With Old Diadem out, the Cross-Back Orbweaver's own Retreat fires on the same attack and adds nothing; let the Orbweaver retreat after its second attack so the two stack visibly.
The Grand Tyler's hand-springing is the hardest card to follow; showing the hand card light up and fly to the dead unit's slot would carry most of the reading.
The fantasy lands in play, not just names: Tapwell can never be let in, Ashby's nieces drop off his back, Diadem's re-spun web is Retreat. Keep naming new cards this way.

standouts.why: Tapwell knocks on every door and can never gain Lie in Wait: the joke and the job are the same line.
Brother Atypus stabs the enemy across and ducks back after each kill: the purse-web spider in one readable card.
Grit-Dresser makes empty slots a resource, a clean standing choice a player sees on the board.

weakest.why: Signora Corkhinge's text is mostly a list of what can't open her; strong idea, heavy to read.
The Grand Tyler stacks hand order, per-card limits and a Lid-only window; hard to read at a glance.
Purse-Web Treasurer is plain rent with little to watch in the fight.

flags.note: Whether "your other units" includes Lids during a fight.
Unsprung Lids count as surviving units for hero damage, so a Long Wait board can hit hard without its Lids ever fighting.
Gossamer Jill's Discover every turn is easy to turn on with knocks.
